test_train_loop_with_callbacks: test the train.train function with callbacks to track step counter, epoch, iteration, and learning rate
test_train_with_start_and_end_steps: test training with specific start_step and end_step using Step.from_epoch to control training range
test_train_zero_steps: test that train.train with zero steps leaves model weights unchanged and callback is never invoked
test_train_in_parts: test resuming training across multiple calls by chaining start_step and end_step to continue from where previous run ended
test_repeatable_data_order_with_seed: test that setting data_order_seed produces identical model states across repeated training runs on the same step
